name: hero_A
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Original Oathroll game art, Ledger & Lamplight. Painterly cinematic dark fantasy, rich oil-paint surfaces and bold deliberate brush masses, strong value contrast, readable silhouettes, restrained texture without film grain or tiny noise. Ink #14110F, Soot #221C18, Vellum #EDE3CF, faded ink #8A7F70, vermilion wax #B8322A, gilt #C9A24A, verdigris #3E8E7E; cold sea-blue darkness against one warm candlelight source. Eerie, melancholy, wondrous, never gory. Entirely original designs. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, writing, typographic runes, logos or watermarks; any ledger pages are completely blank and wax seals bear only a plain abstract circle.
Asset type: website hero, style A.
Landscape 16:9, highest available resolution, ideally 3840x2160. Moonlit low-tide sea at Saltmere, flooded medieval stone belfry rising at right of centre, tall broken silhouette against a misty pale moon at upper left, one tiny amber-lit window high in the tower. Drowned roof peaks and reflections in cold dark water. In extreme foreground along bottom edge, a notary desk edge with a blank open vellum ledger at left, a single burning candle left of centre, and a prominent round vermilion wax seal on blank paper at lower centre. Tower top and candle flame both fully within frame. Strong diagonal visual route from red seal through candle toward tower; dark quiet left middle area allows later UI text. No person in this hero. Eye-catching key art, cinematic depth, grand tower versus intimate candle. The window echoes the candle's warm light; ambient moonlight is cold.
